incomeAssessment.scope: Targeted household citation burdens, injury/private-care payments, insurance and support-access costs; original camera health reference retained.
incomeAssessment.rationale: Free navigation supplies a resource mechanism but not measured retained private payments or a current financial cohort. Camera-fine payer counts, actual reductions and payment incidence must be tied to residual deployment rather than prevented deaths or all planned cameras.
directions: Fines and fees reduce cited households resources in full; public citation revenue is a transfer, not client benefit.
Low-income discounts and actual payment/appeal rates change incidence but do not establish zero burden.
Avoided injury payments and insurance/compensation gains require net fees, baseline cover and household sharing; no retail bills or survivor wages.
Full access/time/legal costs remain independent of clinical response; positive health overlap limits gains only; public real-resource costs separate.
